# Documentation Version Template

Copy this checklist when creating or advancing a documentation version.

Version: `vX.Y.Z`

Date: `YYYY-MM-DD`

Associated Git commit: `pending until commit exists`

## Scope

- Implemented changes:
- Planned or documented-only changes:
- Breaking changes:

## Required Updates

- [ ] Create `docs/versions/vX.Y.Z/`.
- [ ] Preserve prior documentation versions.
- [ ] Update `docs/current.md`.
- [ ] Update `docs/changelog.md`.
- [ ] Record the associated Git commit after commit creation when practical.
- [ ] Distinguish implemented functionality from planned functionality.
- [ ] Run `./scripts/validate-docs-links.sh`.
